lens: iOS information hierarchy, reachability, and accessibility for the dedicated Agent destination

findings.observation: The changed artifact now proves the Agent entry on both the original iPhone 17 Pro English path and a compact iPhone SE 3rd Gen Simplified Chinese AX5 path, but the evidence bundle still does not include a focused VoiceOver traversal or spoken-order audit.
findings.evidence: Frozen scope: docs/evaluations/2026-09-03-agent-crm-redesign/scope.md. Compact/AX5 and primary screenshots are linked there. Both focused Agent UI tests passed in apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift.
findings.user_impact: This is a bounded remaining gap rather than a visible defect, but spoken navigation order and announcement quality are still not directly proven from the frozen artifact.
findings.recommendation: Add one explicit VoiceOver-oriented UI audit or scripted accessibility walk for the orb entry, the four first-level rows, and the Sources screen headings and status chips.
findings.verification: Capture a VoiceOver traversal record or equivalent accessibility inspection showing the entry control, the Agent title, the four rows, and the planned-versus-available sections in stable order without ambiguous announcements.

strengths: The dedicated Agent entry is now semantically aligned with its control name and the focused Agent-entry UI test passes with the identifier relationship-agent-studio.
The design stays sparse and legible on the primary reviewed surface: four first-level controls only, with no spill of setup clutter into Today.
The compact-width and localization risk is materially reduced by a passing Simplified Chinese AX5 run on iPhone SE 3rd Gen plus matching screenshots.
The Sources screen keeps current capability, reference-only LinkedIn identity, and planned imports visually distinct.
The core interaction is executable rather than conceptual: both focused UI tests passed on September 3, 2026.
missing_evidence: No frozen VoiceOver traversal transcript or announcement-level audit for the dedicated Agent destination.
No explicit evidence bundle entry for switch control or keyboard-style accessibility navigation, though this is lower priority than VoiceOver for the current slice.
open_questions: When real import flows replace the planned rows, will the same sparse structure survive without pushing review, status, and failure states back into a cluttered configuration page?
Should the compact-device AX5 screenshots be treated as a required baseline for later Agent destination changes?
